title: kernel.hub.release@1 (decision kind, floor confirm, safety send): bound args
description: Release a send this machine's mods staged for the team hub (inventory K13, K19; sendgate). During the overlap the args are the v2 Inbox item as it was shown (its text by ref) and the v2 action each option runs; the bind re-checks the live item at claim. Binds the exact staged bytes (payload). Preview rows, in order: Who, Project, Effect, Note, Details. Options: approve 'Send' (confirm), decline 'Hold back' (narrow). Known debt: the generic {title, text, who, project} shape binds the v2 Inbox item as shown, and must become real args by P7.

payload.description: The staged envelope exactly as sendgate holds it (JCS), by content hash: re-checked at claim, so a payload changed under an unchanged preview is not sent
